---
title: "Schedule"
date: ""
toc: false
number-sections: false
sidebar: false
toastui:
  schedule:
    defaultView: week
    file: "schedule.csv"
    file-sep: ","
    date: "2026-11-16"
    useDetailPopup: true
    isReadOnly: true
    height: 980px
    timegridHeight: 900px
    eventDetailItems:
      - attendees
    popupDetailItems:
      - attendees
      - calendar
    week:
      workweek: true
      taskView: false
      eventView: ['time']
      showNowIndicator: true
    autoHourRange: true
    timezone:
      zones:
        - timezoneName: Europe/Stockholm
    # colours follow the site palette in styles.scss: session is $tertiary with $primary, extra is $accent
    calendars:
      - id: "session"
        name: "Session"
        color: inherit
        backgroundColor: "#D1E5E6"
        dragBackgroundColor: "#D1E5E6"
        borderColor: "#4C979F"
      - id: "free"
        name: "Free"
        color: inherit
        backgroundColor: "#F1EBDD"
        dragBackgroundColor: "#F1EBDD"
        borderColor: "#D9CBA8"
      - id: "extra"
        name: "Extra"
        color: inherit
        backgroundColor: "#F5E1DA"
        dragBackgroundColor: "#F5E1DA"
        borderColor: "#CF6A45"
format: html
---

<!-- Remember to set first day of schedule and file path in the YAML above -->
{{< toastui schedule >}}
